spec.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Fadyme battle animation atlas PAGE A of a two-page atlas. New original SD chibi sprite art.
Image 1 supplies ONLY adult identity/costume: Fadyme, 22, ash-blonde hair, violet eyes, pointed plum hood and layered modest plum travelling robe with fine silver embroidery, white neck scarf, dark gloves and belt. Image 2 supplies ONLY Gothic-anime chibi contour/cel-shading style; do not copy Mahmut, weapons, shield or sixteen-cell layout.
Create a native LANDSCAPE 3:2 PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS AND TWO ROWS, ONLY EIGHT chibis total. Use the extra cell height for generous empty transparent gaps. Each identical cell is 25% image width and 50% image height. Every complete chibi with all hands, cloth and bell fits within central 65% cell width and central 65% cell height. No overlap/touching between figures or rows, no near touching. A broad transparent band divides the two rows. Native resolution 1536x1024 or larger without upscaling.
Each chibi is TWO HEADS tall, large head ~half total height, slim petite adult body, facing RIGHT in the same three-quarter side view. Same head scale, costume, light and camera in all eight cells. Exactly ONE small bronze handbell held on a short chain by her gloved hand, always attached and always above boots. Her belt carries NO bell or metal pendant; front hanging panels are visibly fabric, not bell shapes. No staff, weapon, wings, extra limbs or new objects.
Eight cells, left to right:
top row: (1) idle composed, bell near waist, (2) idle inhale with tiny shoulder lift, (3) idle exhale with robe settling, (4) a small walking step.
bottom row: (5) basic anticipation, bell hand drawn slightly back, (6) basic impact, compact forward bell-hand gesture, (7) basic recovery returning bell close to waist, (8) active anticipation with both hands together holding the single bell near chest.
All standing boot soles share the same ground level inside each row. Keep exactly two arms/hands and two feet, no detached bell duplicates. No ground, shadow, particles, glow, trail, VFX, color background, labels, numbers, grid or checkerboard. Clean dark-plum contour, refined cel shading and subtle painted fabric detail. A sparse, roomy eight-cell production sheet; do not add any additional row or figures.

review.note: New SD battle atlas, sixteen separated poses, eight named states with short explicit frame sequences. Not a rig or sixteen unique frames per state. Human art/native-2K/device gates remain open.
